files.description: Contentful API response for the EHI Export overview/welcome page. Contains rich text body with introduction, use cases, and export type descriptions.

Contentful API response for the Ambulatory Clinical EHI Export page. Contains dataset list (64 datasets), field specifications for Care Plan Events and Eye Care Measurements, file format info (NDJSON), and folder structure conventions.

Contentful API response for the Ambulatory Collector EHI Export page. Contains billing/demographics dataset list (15 datasets), referral authorization attachment specs, claim attachment specs, and folder structure.

Contentful API response for the Inpatient Clinical EHI Export page. Contains dataset list (38 datasets) including hospital-specific sections like Flowsheets, ED Notes, Nursing documentation, and MAR. Format is HTML (not JSON like ambulatory).

Contentful API response for the Inpatient Collector EHI Export page. Contains billing/demographics dataset list (16 datasets — same as ambulatory plus Visits and Charge Details), referral auth specs, and folder structure.
Contentful API response for the Release Notes page. Effectively empty — states 'This feature is set to be released within 2023' with no actual release notes posted as of Feb 2026.
Navigation structure for the Data Exports documentation portal. Lists all nav items and their hrefs.
Microsite configuration for the Data Exports portal. Shows tabs (Documentation, Support) and content type mapping.

PDF data dictionary for Ambulatory Clinical EHI Export. 10 pages covering file formats, folder structure/naming conventions, dataset list with API spec links for 64+ datasets, and inline field specs for Care Plan Events and Eye Care Measurements. Created Sep 22, 2023.

PDF data dictionary for Ambulatory Collector EHI Export. 7 pages covering billing/demographics datasets (15 datasets), file formats, folder structure, and specs for referral authorization attachments and claim attachments. Created Sep 22, 2023.

PDF data dictionary for Inpatient Clinical EHI Export. 37 pages — the most detailed document. Contains field-level HTML template specifications for 38 hospital-specific datasets including Patient Demographics, Admission H&P, Discharge Summary, Flowsheets (Vitals, ADLs, I&O, etc.), ED documentation, Nursing notes, MAR, Orders, Lab Results, Imaging, and more. Created Sep 22, 2023.

PDF data dictionary for Inpatient Collector EHI Export. 7 pages covering billing/demographics datasets (16 datasets — ambulatory set plus Visits and Charge Details), file formats, folder structure, and attachment specs. Created Sep 22, 2023.

Bun TypeScript enrichment script. Parses Contentful rich text from API JSON files and extracts structured dataset catalog.

Extracted structured dataset catalog: 133 datasets across 4 export types (ambulatory clinical, ambulatory collector, inpatient clinical, inpatient collector), with spec URLs, attachment indicators, inline field specs, and headings.
Enrichment coverage accounting: 6/6 API files parsed with 0 failures.
Enrichment script documentation: run commands, input/output boundaries, known limitations.

Browser-captured a11y tree snapshot of the Patient Cases API spec page. Contains full input/output parameter definitions for all Patient Case endpoints including Get list of patient case documents (35 output fields). Patient Cases are used for clinical phone calls and portal messages.

55 OpenAPI-style JSON spec files for all api-ref endpoints referenced by the EHI export documentation, fetched via athenahealth's Contentful exploreDocs API. Each file contains full endpoint definitions with input parameters, output parameters (OpenAPI schema with field names, types, descriptions), request bodies, and operation metadata. Covers all 55 proprietary API endpoints (excludes 10 FHIR R4 endpoints which use standard FHIR specs).
